g.text: Human forecasts of AI solving open mathematics
One row per survey group. Bubble area and labels show the reported probability.
Earlier survey: red Later survey: blue
ESPAI averages fitted probability distributions. LEAP reports median respondent probabilities.
The shaded rows are part of the all-expert sample. The questions and methods differ between surveys.
Sources: AI Impacts ESPAI 2023/2024; FRI LEAP wave 2. Data saved 30 Sep 2026.
